title: Teodoro backs tight scrutiny of China state firm funds sent to PH execs
summary: MANILA, Philippines—Any funds given to a public official by a Chinese state-owned enterprise must be subjected to the “highest level of scrutiny,” according to Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro…
